caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a wooden scoop or ladle with a handle. The object is oriented horizontally with the handle on the left side. The color of the scoop is a medium to dark brown, resembling the natural tone of wood, with slightly lighter shades inside the hollowed-out portion of the scoop, and faint wood grain patterns visible. The handle is large, oval-shaped with an open space, and integrates smoothly into the body of the scoop. The scoop itself is elongated and somewhat oval, with a pointed end on the right side. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition. The object is centrally placed and positioned with no shadows or additional details in the background. The artist's signature, "Wilbur M. Rice," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Wooden Meal Scoop
